sender_reader_impossibility_control.interpretation: Each identical sender input occurs with both actual reader labels; a deterministic classifier cannot distinguish them.

yes_no_behavior.interpretation: Elicited answers against stipulated fictional-state gold; not measured hidden beliefs.

omniscient.probability_verification_scope: NumPy scorer versus fixed-C reconstruction; aggregate metrics versus source report, which has no saved per-row probabilities

sender.probability_verification_scope: NumPy scorer versus fixed-C reconstruction; aggregate metrics versus source report, which has no saved per-row probabilities

strict.interpretation: Post hoc question-format diagnostic on previously inspected development cases. A/B recovery indicates format sensitivity; failure is bounded to tested formats. This is not new held-out confirmation or evidence of hidden belief validity.

choice_format.scope: Same scenes and known development cases; wording and response format jointly change; no new holdout confirmation.

independent_audit.limits: Secondary learned-head probability NLLs were not independently reconstructed; classification cells were checked from their confusion matrices.

limitations: Only two held-out wording groups; repeated cells and cached views are not independent templates.
Same logical family, checkpoint and NF4/BF16 precision; not broad story-family/model/precision generalization.
Normative character-state labels still need independent human semantic review.
Nested query-free primary heads remain near chance; text controls are preliminary lexical methods.
Explicit question answers show default-response and format sensitivity; no demonstrated reliable neutral nested capability.
Factored factual control uses an external rule; test improvement does not establish spontaneous nested representation, especially with poor validation.
Prior perspective tracking, known-message updating and unknown-message outcome forecasting remain distinct.

composition.interpretation: World and attendance are separately decoded, then an external hard XNOR computes normative prior nested labels; not spontaneous nested representation.
composition.v1_v2_aggregate_equivalence: exact; v2 adds row predictions and parameter sidecar only
composition.limits: Sender validation worsens; two held-out wording groups; no robust or spontaneous-belief advantage claim.

software_validation.meaning: Software checks are separate from construct validity and scientific generalization.
